stem.text: A couple applies a clockwise torque of $9.0\,\text{N m}$ to a circular disc.

A.alt: Diagram of a shaded circular disc with a vertical double-headed line through its centre and two horizontal arrows attached at the top and bottom of its rim, labelled 9.0 N and 9.0 N, with a line labelled 50 cm from the centre.

B.alt: Diagram of a shaded circular disc with a vertical double-headed line through its centre and two horizontal arrows at the top and bottom of its rim, labelled 45 N and 45 N, with a line labelled 20 cm from the centre.

C.alt: Diagram of a shaded circular disc with a vertical double-headed line through its centre and two horizontal arrows at the top and bottom of its rim, labelled 45 N and 45 N, with a line labelled 10 cm from the centre.

D.alt: Diagram of a shaded circular disc with a vertical double-headed line through its centre and two horizontal arrows at the top and bottom of its rim, labelled 9.0 N and 9.0 N, with a line labelled 100 cm from the centre.
